question: Should this updater wait for openclaw/design-system to become public, or should ClawHub add an explicit private read credential/GitHub App token now?
rationale: The code path is structurally clear, but choosing and granting cross-repository read access for a write-capable scheduled workflow is a repository security and operations decision, not a safe automatic repair.

options.title: Use approved read credential
options.body: Wire DESIGN_SYSTEM_READ_TOKEN or a GitHub App token through both the release lookup and git install path, then require hosted dispatch proof before merge.

options.title: Wait for public source
options.body: Keep this draft paused until openclaw/design-system is public and the default-token path can be proven on GitHub-hosted runners.

options.title: Keep updates manual
options.body: Close or defer the updater if daily write-capable skill vendoring is not worth the credential and supply-chain surface.

recommendation.title: Use approved read credential
recommendation.body: Wire DESIGN_SYSTEM_READ_TOKEN or a GitHub App token through both the release lookup and git install path, then require hosted dispatch proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick has the strongest current-main history on the existing automation surface and is also the author carrying the stacked design-system work.
